title: Shift Intake and Output Summary
brief: A 12-hour day shift intake and output flow sheet summary for an adult medical-surgical patient receiving IV maintenance fluids and oral intake.

# Shift Intake and Output Summary
Patient: Arthur Vance | DOB: 04/14/1958 | MRN: 904281 | Room: 412-B
Provider: Dr. Evelyn Reed, MD | Shift: Day (0700-1930) | Date: 10/14/2026

## Intake Reference Log
| Time | Source | Description | Amount (mL) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0800 | Oral | Coffee (6 oz) and apple juice (4 oz) | 300 |
| 1000 | IV Infusion | 0.9% Normal Saline at 75 mL/hr (0700-1100) | 300 |
| 1200 | Oral | Chicken broth (8 oz) and water (8 oz) | 480 |
| 1500 | IV Infusion | 0.9% Normal Saline at 75 mL/hr (1100-1500) | 300 |
| 1730 | Oral | Gelatin dessert (4 oz) and hot tea (6 oz) | 300 |
| 1900 | IV Infusion | 0.9% Normal Saline at 75 mL/hr (1500-1900) | 300 |

## Output Reference Log
| Time | Source | Description | Amount (mL) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0915 | Void | Clear amber urine | 350 |
| 1345 | Void | Clear amber urine | 425 |
| 1630 | Emesis | Bilious stomach contents | 175 |
| 1845 | Void | Clear pale yellow urine | 400 |

## Clinical Notes and Totals
- Patient tolerated oral liquids without nausea until mid-afternoon emesis episode.
- Total recorded shift oral intake equals 880 mL across breakfast, lunch, and dinner periods.
- Total IV intake recorded is 900 mL from continuous normal saline infusion.
- Total shift fluid output equals 1350 mL across all routes.
- Measured urine output via calibrated collection container was emptied directly into the bedside handwashing sink.
- Net fluid balance for the 12-hour shift is positive 330 mL.
- Notified RN of emesis and provided oral care at 1645.

Documented by: Marcus Brody, LVN | License: #318942

errors.quote: Total recorded shift oral intake equals 880 mL across breakfast, lunch, and dinner periods.
errors.explanation: The intake reference table shows oral intakes of 300 mL at 0800, 480 mL at 1200, and 300 mL at 1730, which sums to 1080 mL, not 880 mL.
errors.fix: Total recorded shift oral intake equals 1080 mL across breakfast, lunch, and dinner periods.

errors.quote: emptied directly into the bedside handwashing sink
errors.explanation: OSHA bloodborne pathogens standards and hospital infection control standards strictly prohibit disposing of bodily fluids into handwashing sinks; bodily waste must be emptied into a designated hopper, commode, or sluice sink.
errors.fix: emptied directly into the patient bathroom commode
